title: Exercise fixture LLM quality gate
description:
## Issue Goal

Exercise the optional LLM-assisted Issue Quality Gate fixture path.

## Why Now

Jade Symphony needs deterministic local coverage for the LLM gate contract without hosted credentials.

## Issue Context

The deterministic gate should pass first, then the configured fixture command should return structured LLM output.

## Decisions / Assumptions

### Decisions

- Keep deterministic checks authoritative.

### Assumptions

- A shell fixture is enough for local LLM gate contract tests.

## Non-Negotiable Guardrails

- Do not call a hosted LLM provider.

## Scope

### In Scope

- Run the fixture LLM gate command.

### Out of Scope

- Hosted provider SDK integration.

## Canonical References

### Target Repository / Package

- Alive24/jade-symphony

### Relevant Knowledge Sources

- README.md

### Relevant Code Paths

- src/quality_gate.rs

## Current State

The deterministic gate and LLM gate fixture command exist.

## Deliverable Shape

Fixture verification only.

## Risks or Constraints

- The LLM gate must not bypass deterministic failures.

## Expected Outcome

The fixture issue remains dispatchable and records LLM gate notes.

## Verification

### Completion Criteria

- LLM fixture gate returns structured output.

### Functional Verification

- cargo test

### UAT

- Run `cargo run -- forge validate --workflow examples/llm-gate-workflow.md '#1'`.

### Context Verification

- Confirm deterministic checks run before LLM output is applied.
